summary.text: Michele Carringer is a Republican state representative who has represented Tennessee House of Representatives District 16 since November 3, 2020, and she is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Michele Carringer lives in Knoxville, Tennessee, and graduated from Central High School in 1980.
She succeeded Bill Dunn in the District 16 seat.

In the 2023-2024 session she chaired the Naming and Designating Committee and was also assigned to the Criminal Justice, Health, Local Government, State Government, and Transportation committees, among others.
